truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.3.0; fixed in 2.3.0. The Proxy-Authorization header was kept on redirects.
The advisory links no commit, only issue #1885.

fe4c4f14 is the merge of PR #1951 'proxyauth' (commits 6d7e8a97, 97cf16e9, 4d8cb324, 4f6dca42, 724038e4, 90f73378). 4d8cb324 adds SessionRedirectMixin.rebuild_proxies, which deletes Proxy-Authorization and re-adds it only from the proxy URL for the new request, and calls it from resolve_redirects. https://github.com/psf/requests/pull/1951
459f8dfc 'Don't repopulate proxies if we don't trust the env' (2014-04-26, before v2.3.0) adjusts the new method to respect trust_env.
The only pre-fix function modified is resolve_redirects (the call to rebuild_proxies is inserted into it). rebuild_auth, rebuild_proxies and utils.should_bypass_proxies are added by the fix.
Entry points: as for the sibling advisory, every request path reaches resolve_redirects.
notes: Shares its vulnerable function with GHSA-cfj3-7x9c-4p3h: the two 2014 advisories differ only in which header leaked.
